envelope.description: Make the subscribe function injectable and tolerate its failure

body.title: Make the subscribe function injectable and tolerate its failure
body.summary: Give the Watcher an optional subscribe function argument that defaults to the real @parcel/watcher subscribe, so a test can force the per-directory subscribe to fail. When it fails, log a warning with the directory, keep no entry for it, and still scan so the files present are reported once. Tolerate a throwing readdir or lstat during the scan by skipping that entry. Add the failure-injection test and the unreadable-directory test (mode 000, skipped as root) to watcher-new-directories.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: With a subscribe function that throws for the per-directory call, addRepo and later events do not throw, a warning is logged, and the files present in the new directory are still reported once
A new nested directory that cannot be read does not throw and does not stop later events for other directories
new Watcher() with no argument still uses the real subscribe, as both existing callers do

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/watcher-new-directories.test.ts: a per-directory subscribe that throws is logged, does not throw out of the handler, and the files present in the new directory are still reported once
src/indexer/__tests__/watcher-new-directories.test.ts: a new nested directory that cannot be read (mode 000, skipped when running as root) does not throw or stop later events for other directories
